KKA0135-BPK6.lead: Small offset palette knife for cupcakes, small cakes and neat touch-ups.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bend Palette Knife, size 6, pairs a 15 cm flat metal blade with a black plastic grip. The short length gives close control when spreading buttercream on cupcake tops or filling the layers of a small round cake.

Because the blade steps down below the grip, it lies level on the icing while your fingers stay above the surface. Cake shops and home bakers reach for this size when finishing half-kilo and jar cakes or tart fillings.
b: Size 6: 15 cm blade, roughly 3 cm wide, on a 12 cm handle.
Offset Bend: The drop near the grip keeps knuckles out of the cream.
Build: Flat metal blade set into a black plastic handle.
Short Reach: Handy for ganache in jars, smoothing tart cream and lifting chocolate decorations.
KKA0135-BPK6.suit: Cupcakes, jar cakes, half-kilo rounds, tart fillings and small decorating jobs at bakeries and home counters.
KKA0135-BPK6.care: Wash by hand in warm soapy water and dry it straight away. Do not leave the plastic handle soaking, and store the knife flat in a drawer or tool roll.
KKA0135-BPK6.title: Black Handle Bend Palette Knife 6 (15 cm)
KKA0135-BPK6.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 6 bend palette knife with a 15 cm offset blade and black plastic handle for icing cupcakes, jar cakes and small round cakes.
conflicts: Listing weight shows 55 g on all four sizes (6/8/10/12) — looks copied from the parent; weight not written.

KKA0136-BPK8.lead: A mid-length offset palette knife for everyday cake icing.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bend Palette Knife in size 8 carries a 20 cm metal blade. It is long enough to sweep across a one-kilo round cake, yet still easy to turn around the sides.

Bakery staff use this length for crumb coats, levelling whipped cream and spreading jam or ganache between sponge layers. The bend below the grip lets the blade sit flat on the cake top without the hand dragging through the finish.
b: Size 8: 20 cm blade, about 3 cm across, fitted to a 12 cm handle.
Angled Neck: The step just ahead of the grip keeps your hand clear of fresh icing.
Build: Flat metal blade set into a black plastic handle.
Daily Icing: Covers crumb coating, whipped-cream finishes and filling between layers.
KKA0136-BPK8.suit: Crumb coats, whipped-cream finishes, layer fillings and one-kilo round cakes in cake shops, bakeries and hotel pastry sections.
KKA0136-BPK8.care: Wash by hand in warm soapy water and dry it straight away. Do not leave the plastic handle soaking, and store the knife flat in a drawer or tool roll.
KKA0136-BPK8.title: Black Handle Bend Palette Knife 8 (20 cm)
KKA0136-BPK8.meta: Size 8 bend palette knife from Kitchenary Kart: 20 cm offset metal blade and black plastic grip for crumb coats, cream finishes and layer fillings.
conflicts: Listing weight shows 55 g on all four sizes (6/8/10/12) — looks copied from the parent; weight not written.

KKA0137-BPK10.lead: A longer offset palette knife for bigger cakes and wide tops.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bend Palette Knife, size 10, has a 25 cm metal blade fixed to a black plastic handle. The extra reach lets a decorator smooth the top of a two-kilo cake or a tall tier with fewer passes, which leaves fewer marks in the cream.

Hotel pastry kitchens and banquet caterers also use this length to spread fillings over square and rectangular cakes and to level buttercream before fondant goes on. The dropped blade stays parallel to the cake while the grip rides above the rim.
b: Size 10: 25 cm blade, close to 3 cm wide, on a 12 cm handle.
Stepped Neck: The bend lowers the working surface so the hand stays off the cake.
Build: Metal blade with a black plastic handle and an offset bend near the grip.
Larger Surfaces: Reaches across two-kilo rounds, square tops and tall tiers.
KKA0137-BPK10.suit: Two-kilo rounds, tiered and square cakes, and buttercream under fondant in hotel pastry kitchens, banquet halls and cake studios.
KKA0137-BPK10.care: Hand wash, rinse and wipe dry before putting it away. Keep it flat in a drawer so the bend stays true, and away from open flame.
KKA0137-BPK10.title: Black Handle Bend Palette Knife 10 (25 cm)
KKA0137-BPK10.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 10 bend palette knife: 25 cm offset blade on a black plastic handle to smooth two-kilo cakes, tall tiers and square cake tops.
conflicts: Listing weight shows 55 g on all four sizes (6/8/10/12) — looks copied from the parent; weight not written.

KKA0138-BPK12.lead: The longest size of this palette knife, for sheet cakes and tray bakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Bend Palette Knife in size 12 runs a 30 cm metal blade from a black plastic handle. That length spans a sheet cake or tray bake in one sweep, so large surfaces come out level without joins in the icing.

Bakeries also use it to spread sponge batter evenly in Swiss roll trays and to work melted chocolate on a slab. The offset keeps the hand above the rim of deep trays while the blade stays flat on the surface.
b: Size 12: 30 cm blade, around 3 cm wide, with a 12 cm handle.
Deep-Tray Reach: The offset clears the side walls of baking trays and cake boards.
Build: Metal blade with a black plastic handle and an offset bend near the grip.
Big Batches: Spreads frosting over brownie slabs, sponge sheets and large celebration bakes.
KKA0138-BPK12.suit: Sheet cakes, tray bakes, Swiss roll sponges and large event orders in commercial bakeries, catering units and hotel pastry rooms.
KKA0138-BPK12.care: Hand wash, rinse and wipe dry before putting it away. Keep it flat in a drawer so the bend stays true, and away from open flame.
KKA0138-BPK12.title: Black Handle Bend Palette Knife 12 (30 cm)
KKA0138-BPK12.meta: Size 12 bend palette knife by Kitchenary Kart with a 30 cm offset blade and black plastic handle for sheet cakes, tray bakes and Swiss roll sponge.
conflicts: Listing weight shows 55 g on all four sizes (6/8/10/12) — looks copied from the parent; weight not written.

KKA0139-BTT.lead: A covered butter dish with a see-through top and a steel knife.
p: The Kitchenary Kart PC Butter Holder Tray with Lid & SS Butter Slicer Knife in the Transparent option has a white polycarbonate base under a clear cover with a white knob. Staff can check how much butter is left without lifting the top.
Closed, the tray measures about 19 cm long and 7 cm high. The stainless steel knife in the set has a flat spreading blade at one end and a short pronged tip at the other.
b: Transparent Option: Clear top over a white base, so the contents stay visible on the table.
Size: About 19 cm long and 7 cm tall when covered.
Top Knob: A raised knob lets you lift the cover with one hand.
Steel Knife: Stainless steel, with a spreading blade and a pronged end.
Material: Polycarbonate tray and lid.
KKA0139-BTT.suit: Breakfast buffets, hotel room service, café counters and home dining tables.
KKA0139-BTT.care: Wash all three pieces in warm soapy water, rinse and dry fully before refilling. Keep the covered dish in the fridge or a cool spot, and avoid scouring pads that can scratch the plastic.
KKA0139-BTT.title: PC Butter Tray, Lid & SS Knife Transparent
KKA0139-BTT.meta: Kitchenary Kart PC butter tray with a clear lid, white base and steel butter knife, about 19 cm long, for buffets, room service and café tables.
conflicts: Variant is named 'Transparent', but photos show only the lid is clear; the base and knob are white. Written as clear lid on a white base.

KKA0140-BTB.lead: A black butter dish and cover, packed with a steel knife.
p: The Kitchenary Kart PC Butter Holder Tray with Lid & SS Butter Slicer Knife in Black has a glossy black polycarbonate base and an opaque top with a round knob. The solid cover keeps butter out of direct light between servings.
With its cover on, the dish is roughly 19 cm long and 7 cm tall. A stainless steel knife comes packed with it, flat for spreading at one end and pronged at the other.
b: Black Option: Opaque base and top with a matching knob.
Dimensions: Roughly 19 cm in length and 7 cm in height.
Storage: The top rests over the base to protect the contents between uses.
Steel Knife: Stainless steel, with a spreading blade and a pronged end.
Material: Polycarbonate tray and lid.
KKA0140-BTB.suit: Restaurant tables, hotel breakfast lines, café counters and home kitchens that want a dark, opaque cover.
KKA0140-BTB.care: Wash all three pieces in warm soapy water, rinse and dry fully before refilling. Keep the covered dish in the fridge or a cool spot, and avoid scouring pads that can scratch the plastic.
KKA0140-BTB.title: PC Butter Tray, Lid & SS Knife – Black
KKA0140-BTB.meta: Black PC butter tray with lid and stainless steel knife from Kitchenary Kart, about 19 x 7 cm, for restaurant tables, breakfast lines and homes.
conflicts: One lifestyle photo on the Black option shows the white/clear version being carried; not described.

KKA0141-PCK4.lead: Four white-handled carving knives for fruit and vegetable garnish work.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Handle Carving Knives 4PP is a set of four small knives with white plastic handles, each about 16 cm long. Every blade has a different tip, so a garnish chef can switch between cutting petals, scooping curves and scoring fine lines.

The set includes a short knife with a gently curved edge, a hooked blade, a slim spear-like point and one with a stepped back that ends in a fine tip. Hotel buffets and wedding caterers use sets like this for watermelon, papaya, carrot and radish carvings.
b: Pack of 4: Four knives, no two with the same tip.
Size: Around 16 cm overall, with handles about 3 cm wide.
Blade Tips: Gently curved, hooked, slim straight and stepped-back points.
White Handles: Plastic grips that are easy to spot on a busy garnish station.
KKA0141-PCK4.suit: Fruit and vegetable carving, buffet displays, salad garnish and culinary training at hotels, event caterers and hospitality institutes.
KKA0141-PCK4.care: Wash each knife by hand and dry it at once. Keep the fine tips covered or in a knife roll, and pick them up by the handle, never the blade.
KKA0141-PCK4.title: Plastic Handle Carving Knives – Pack of 4
KKA0141-PCK4.meta: Set of 4 white plastic-handle carving knives from Kitchenary Kart, about 16 cm each, with four tip shapes for fruit and vegetable garnish work.

KKA0142-231.lead: A needle-point carving knife for fine lines on fruit and vegetables.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 231 has a narrow triangular blade that tapers to a very fine point, set in a dark plastic handle. Overall length is about 19 cm, with a grip roughly 2 cm wide.

The sharp tip is made for piercing and tracing: cutting leaf veins into cucumber skin, scoring petals on radish or outlining a design on watermelon rind before the deeper cuts. It also handles small peeling jobs on apples and pears.
b: Model 231: Straight, slim blade narrowing to a needle point.
Length: Around 19 cm from tip to handle end.
Handle: Dark plastic grip with a small step near the blade.
Detail Work: Traces outlines and scores patterns ahead of the main cuts.
KKA0142-231.suit: Garnish outlines, scoring fruit skins, small peeling tasks and vegetable carving in hotel kitchens, buffets and catering prep.
KKA0142-231.care: Rinse and wash by hand soon after use, then dry fully. Store it with the point covered or in a slot so the tip does not bend or catch a finger.
KKA0142-231.title: Plastic Handle Carving Knife 231
KKA0142-231.meta: Kitchenary Kart carving knife 231 with a needle-point triangular blade and plastic handle, about 19 cm long, for scoring and tracing garnish designs.

KKA0143-232.lead: A straight-edged small knife for trimming and shaping garnish pieces.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 232 has a short straight blade whose back curves down to a sharp point, fitted to a dark plastic handle. The knife measures about 19 cm overall, and the handle is close to 2 cm wide.
The wider blade gives a steady straight cut for trimming capsicum, cucumber and carrot into neat pieces before they are shaped. Prep cooks can also use it for everyday paring at the garnish station.
b: Model 232: Straight edge with a spine that drops to the point.
Length: About 19 cm in all, grip near 2 cm across.
Plastic Handle: Dark, smooth grip that wipes clean quickly.
Trim and Pare: Squares off vegetables and cuts neat strips before carving.
KKA0143-232.suit: Trimming capsicum, cucumber and carrot, paring fruit and preparing garnish blanks in restaurant and hotel prep areas.
KKA0143-232.care: Hand wash with a soft sponge, rinse and dry the blade before storing. Keep it in a knife block or guard, with the edge turned away from your hand when you reach for it.
KKA0143-232.title: Plastic Handle Carving Knife 232
KKA0143-232.meta: Carving knife 232 by Kitchenary Kart: straight blade with a dropped point on a plastic handle, about 19 cm, for trimming and paring garnish vegetables.

KKA0144-238.lead: A curved-blade carving knife for rounded cuts on fruit and vegetables.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 238 has a short blade that curves along its length and finishes in a point, mounted on a dark plastic handle. It is about 19 cm long overall with a 2 cm wide grip.

The curve follows round surfaces, which helps when cutting petals on onion, turning mushroom caps, peeling a tomato skin into a rose or shaping round edges on melon. Buffet chefs keep it at hand for the curved parts of a platter design.
b: Model 238: Curved blade that bends toward its point.
Length: Roughly 19 cm, handle about 2 cm wide.
Grip: Dark plastic handle with a raised step behind the blade.
Round Cuts: Follows the shape of onions, tomatoes and melons.
KKA0144-238.suit: Petal cuts, tomato roses, round shapes on melons and onions, and buffet platter garnish in hotels and catering kitchens.
KKA0144-238.care: Wash it by hand after each session and dry it well. Store the curved blade in a sheath or separate slot, and keep fingers clear of the tip when cleaning.
KKA0144-238.title: Plastic Handle Carving Knife 238
KKA0144-238.meta: Kitchenary Kart carving knife 238 has a curved blade and plastic handle, about 19 cm long, for petal cuts, tomato roses and rounded melon garnish.

KKA0146-WCK4.lead: A four-knife fruit carving kit with riveted handles.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Carving Knives 4PP brings four small knives together, each with a brown wooden handle held by two metal rivets. They measure about 16 cm long, and each blade ends in a different tip for a different kind of cut.

One has a narrow stepped blade for fine detail, one a straight triangular point, one a hooked curve and one a gently curved edge. Watermelon roses, apple flowers and patterned melon skins are typical work for this kit at buffets, weddings and hotel displays.
b: Pack of 4: Four knives with four tip shapes in one kit.
Size: About 16 cm in length, handles roughly 3 cm wide.
Wooden Handles: Brown wood fixed with two rivets on every knife.
Tip Shapes: Stepped fine blade, triangular point, hooked curve and gentle curve.
KKA0146-WCK4.suit: Watermelon and apple carving, fruit displays, wedding buffets and garnish training in hotels, caterers and culinary schools.
KKA0146-WCK4.care: Wash the blades by hand and wipe the wooden handles dry; never leave them soaking in water. Keep the four knives in a roll or case with tips covered.
KKA0146-WCK4.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knives – Pack of 4
KKA0146-WCK4.meta: Kitchenary Kart set of 4 wooden-handle carving knives, about 16 cm each, with stepped, pointed and curved tips for watermelon and fruit carving.

KKA0147-WCCK4.lead: A four-piece cheese set with wooden handles for boards and platters.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Cheese Carving Knives 4PP includes four metal pieces on rounded light-wood handles with a metal collar. The set has a pronged knife with holes in the blade, a wide flat chisel, a pointed heart-shaped knife and a two-prong serving fork.

The holes help soft cheese come away from the blade, the chisel breaks chunks off hard blocks, the pointed knife cuts small wedges and the fork holds or serves the pieces. Each one is roughly 12 to 13 cm long, a neat size for a board or grazing platter.
b: Pack of 4: Pronged, chisel and pointed knives plus a two-prong fork.
Size: Each piece about 12–13 cm long; the chisel blade is close to 5 cm wide.
Handles: Rounded light wood finished with a metal collar.
Pronged Knife: Perforated, with a forked tip for lifting slices.
KKA0147-WCCK4.suit: Cheese boards, grazing platters, café counters, hotel buffets and home gatherings with soft or hard varieties.
KKA0147-WCCK4.care: Hand wash only and dry each piece straight after rinsing. Keep the wooden handles out of standing water, and store the set together with the pointed tips facing away from you.
KKA0147-WCCK4.title: Wooden Cheese Carving Knives – Pack of 4
KKA0147-WCCK4.meta: Kitchenary Kart 4-piece wooden-handle cheese set: pronged, chisel and pointed knives plus a serving fork, about 12–13 cm each, for cheese boards.
conflicts: Name says 'Cheese Carving Knives 4PP', but photos show three knives plus a two-prong serving fork (a cheese serving set). Written as a four-piece set: 3 knives + 1 fork.

KKA0148-102.lead: A hooked-blade carving knife for peeling and turning round produce.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 102 has a short blade that sweeps into a hooked point, fixed to a dark wooden handle with two rivets. It is about 15 cm long and roughly 2 cm wide at the grip.

The hooked shape follows the curve of oranges, sweet lime and apples, so it can cut peel patterns, scoop small hollows and turn vegetables into neat barrel shapes. Garnish chefs use it for citrus baskets and fruit bowls on buffet tables.
b: Model 102: Short blade bending into a hooked point.
Length: About 15 cm from tip to end.
Wood Grip: Dark wood secured with two rivets.
Peel Patterns: Cuts designs into orange and sweet lime skins.
KKA0148-102.suit: Citrus peel designs, fruit baskets, turned vegetables and buffet garnish in hotels, banquet kitchens and catering units.
KKA0148-102.care: Clean by hand and dry straight away; do not soak the wooden handle. Keep the hooked tip in a guard or knife roll so it does not snag other tools.
KKA0148-102.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knife 102
KKA0148-102.meta: Kitchenary Kart carving knife 102: hooked blade on a riveted wooden handle, about 15 cm long, for citrus peel designs and turned vegetables.

KKA0149-230.lead: A slim straight carving knife on a light wood grip.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 230 pairs a long, narrow straight blade with a light-coloured wooden handle fixed by two rivets. It measures around 17 cm overall.

The slim profile slips easily into small fruit, making it handy for hulling strawberries, cutting strawberry fans and scoring kiwi or melon skin. Dessert stations and fruit counters often keep one for quick garnish cuts.
b: Model 230: Long, narrow straight blade with a pointed tip.
Length: Around 17 cm, with a 2 cm wide grip.
Light Wood: Pale wooden grip held by two rivets.
Berries: Hulls strawberries and makes fine cuts on grapes and kiwi.
KKA0149-230.suit: Strawberry hulling and fans, kiwi and melon scoring, and dessert garnish at cafés, hotel buffets and juice counters.
KKA0149-230.care: Wash by hand, rinse and towel-dry. Keep the wood away from long soaks, and store the knife point-down in a block or in a sheath.
KKA0149-230.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knife 230
KKA0149-230.meta: Carving knife 230 from Kitchenary Kart with a slim straight blade and light wooden handle, about 17 cm long, for strawberry hulling and fruit fans.

KKA0150-234.lead: A carving knife with a shaped wooden grip for longer garnish sessions.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 234 has a straight tapered blade and a contoured light-wood handle held by three rivets. It is roughly 19 cm long and about 2 cm across the grip.

The curved handle sits into the palm, which helps during long runs of detailed cutting, such as flower patterns on orange peel or leaf shapes on watermelon rind. The pointed tip lets you cut shallow, even lines in the skin.
b: Model 234: Straight blade tapering to a sharp point.
Length: Near 19 cm overall, 2 cm at the handle.
Shaped Grip: Contoured light wood with three rivets.
Peel Designs: Cuts flowers and swirls into orange and melon skin.
KKA0150-234.suit: Orange and melon peel designs, fruit centrepieces and long carving sessions in hotel garde manger sections and catering kitchens.
KKA0150-234.care: Wash the knife by hand and dry both blade and wood at once. Avoid dishwashers and soaking, and keep the point sheathed when it goes back in the drawer.
KKA0150-234.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knife 234
KKA0150-234.meta: Kitchenary Kart carving knife 234 with a tapered blade and contoured wooden grip, about 19 cm long, for peel designs and fruit centrepieces.

KKA0151-237.lead: A straight-handled carving knife that also slices small produce.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 237 has a straight blade narrowing to a point and a flat, reddish-brown wooden handle with two rivets. It runs to about 19 cm in length and 2 cm in width.
Besides carving work, the blade slices capsicum into thin rings, cuts radish for plating and trims garnish pieces to size. The simple rectangular handle is comfortable in a pinch grip or a full fist.
b: Model 237: Straight blade that narrows evenly to its tip.
Length: About 19 cm overall.
Flat Grip: Reddish-brown wood with two rivets.
Plating Prep: Slices capsicum rings and radish for garnish.
KKA0151-237.suit: Capsicum rings, radish and vegetable garnish, plating prep and small carving jobs in restaurant kitchens and catering units.
KKA0151-237.care: Hand wash and dry immediately, keeping the wooden handle out of soaking water. Store it in a block slot or guard with the edge facing away from your fingers.
KKA0151-237.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knife 237
KKA0151-237.meta: Kitchenary Kart carving knife 237: straight pointed blade on a flat riveted wooden handle, about 19 cm, for capsicum rings, radish and plate garnish.
conflicts: Two listing photos show the knife used on a bread loaf and for wood whittling (non-food carving); not described — owner may want to drop the whittling photo.

KKA0152-239.lead: A compact carving knife with a gently curved, upswept tip.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 239 has a short blade with a softly curved edge that rises to a sharp point, on a dark wooden handle with two rivets. It is about 15 cm long overall and 2 cm wide at the grip.

The slight curve helps with rocking cuts on small items, so it works for petal cuts on radish, scalloped edges on citrus and trimming strawberry tops. Its short length keeps the tip close to the fingers for control on fine work.
b: Model 239: Short blade with a gentle curve up to the point.
Length: About 15 cm end to end.
Grip: Dark wood fixed with a pair of rivets.
Petal Cuts: Shapes radish flowers and scalloped citrus edges.
KKA0152-239.suit: Radish flowers, scalloped citrus, strawberry trimming and small garnish detail for hotels, restaurants and event caterers.
KKA0152-239.care: Wash and dry by hand after every use; the wood should not sit in water. Keep the blade in a sheath and hold the knife by its grip while drying.
KKA0152-239.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knife 239
KKA0152-239.meta: Carving knife 239 by Kitchenary Kart with a gently curved, upswept blade on a dark wooden handle, about 15 cm long, for radish flowers and citrus.

KKA0153-240.lead: A spear-point carving knife for piercing and cutting fine shapes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 240 has a narrow triangular blade that comes to a needle-like point, set in a dark wooden handle with two rivets. Length is about 15 cm, and the grip is roughly 2 cm wide.

With both sides tapering to the tip, the blade can pierce the skin at a precise spot and cut small V-shaped notches and zig-zag edges, such as a crown cut on melon halves or boiled eggs. Chefs also use it for lettering and outlines on watermelon rind.
b: Model 240: Triangular spear blade with a needle point.
Length: About 15 cm overall, 2 cm at the grip.
Handle: Dark wood fitted with two rivets.
V-Notches: Cuts zig-zag crowns on melons, lemons and boiled eggs.
KKA0153-240.suit: Zig-zag crowns, V-notches, rind lettering and outline work on melons, lemons and eggs in hotel, banquet and catering kitchens.
KKA0153-240.care: After use, hand wash the knife and dry it thoroughly without soaking the handle. Cap the needle point or keep it in a slotted block, out of reach of children.
KKA0153-240.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knife 240
KKA0153-240.meta: Kitchenary Kart carving knife 240 with a triangular spear blade and dark wooden handle, about 15 cm long, for zig-zag crowns and rind outlines.

KKA0154-242.lead: A short bird's-beak carving knife for curved cuts and peeling.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Kitchen Carving Knife 242 has a short, beak-shaped blade that curves down to its point, fixed to a shaped dark wooden handle with two rivets. It measures about 14 cm long and 2 cm across the grip.

The curved blade wraps around small round produce, so it peels and shapes radish, baby potatoes, mushrooms and cherry tomatoes in one smooth turn. Chefs also use it to cut petals into onions and to take the eyes out of pineapple.
b: Model 242: Short blade that hooks down to a point.
Length: About 14 cm in all.
Shaped Handle: Dark wood with a gentle curve and two rivets.
Turning Cuts: Peels and shapes small round vegetables and fruit.
KKA0154-242.suit: Turned vegetables, pineapple eyes, onion petals, peeled cherry tomatoes and garnish plates in restaurants, hotels and catering setups.
KKA0154-242.care: Wash by hand and pat the blade and wood dry; do not soak. Store the knife in a sheath or drawer insert where the hooked tip cannot catch a hand.
KKA0154-242.title: Wooden Handle Carving Knife 242
KKA0154-242.meta: Carving knife 242 from Kitchenary Kart: short bird's-beak blade on a shaped wooden handle, about 14 cm long, for turned vegetables and peeling.
conflicts: Listing photo 4 shows a sealed retail pack of four wooden-handle carving knives, but the listing is the single knife 242 (21 g); no pack count written.
